purpose: EOIP quality-assurance portfolio. A listed suite is not product acceptance; evidence and environment require review.

suites.coverage: QA runner, Postman generator, target guard and evidence self-tests
All OpenAPI method/path pairs and Postman artifact drift
Dedicated QA request breadth and all unprobed API operations
Successful response schema completeness and API-documentation gaps
Disposable source create, read, duplicate, update, list, delete and absence checks
Existing graph, query and ontology contract tests
Existing auth, CORS, injection and HTTP security tests
Existing privacy/no-egress integration checks
Existing licensing and SBOM policy tests; not a fresh advisory scan
Existing cross-module and service integration tests
Existing capability and release acceptance claims
Existing lifecycle and restart workflows
Existing deterministic grounding, retrieval, model and oracle tests
Existing connector acceptance tests
Existing query, processing, semantic, REVA, research, mapping, wisdom and GUI backend checks
Existing parser/property fuzz cases; not exhaustive fuzzing
Existing deterministic performance tests; not external scale or soak
Existing DLQ and backup/restore acceptance checks
All 18 MCP tool delegations, protocol discovery, auth boundary and upstream failure mapping; mocked upstream behavior is not end-to-end feature proof
Existing React client unit tests
Frontend production build; not UI acceptance
VS Code extension MCP client and demo driver unit tests
VS Code extension-host integration; requires installed Electron/browser dependencies
Mobile/desktop layout and axe checks; requires local Vite and browser
Read-only Postman/Newman auth and operational probes; requires isolated local API and token
Bench-owned in-memory source CRUD, conflict and cleanup workflow via Newman
Read-only live API smoke and boundary probes; requires isolated local API and token
Runtime JSON Schema validation for four explicitly documented GET responses
Two-VU, 30-second readiness smoke; not a production SLO
qa_bench API, Selenium, performance and E2E tests
suites.blocker: Current defaults embed tokens and may use tracked .eoip-data; repair isolation and credentials before orchestration

suites.coverage: Certified real-service connector matrix
suites.blocker: Need sandbox accounts, synthetic datasets and network/egress policy

suites.coverage: Multi-service failover, disaster recovery, RPO/RTO and disruptive chaos
suites.blocker: Need disposable topology, approved outage plan and restore fixture

suites.coverage: Authenticated DAST and penetration review
suites.blocker: Need authorized isolated deployment, scope and scanner policy

suites.coverage: Fresh dependency vulnerability and signed artifact scan
suites.blocker: Need pinned scanner/advisory feed, release artifact and triage owner

suites.coverage: Representative multi-hour load, peak scale and resource leak checks
suites.blocker: Need capacity target, isolated infrastructure and cost budget

suites.coverage: Screen reader, keyboard, contrast, motion comfort and visual review
suites.blocker: Requires human assistive-technology review and sign-off

suites.coverage: Firefox, WebKit, Edge, mobile-device and installed-extension matrix
suites.blocker: Need supported-platform policy and browser/device infrastructure
